notes:
{荷造|にづく}り is a general term for packing, commonly used for moving or travel.

WORD TYPE:
- Noun
- Also used as ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {荷造|にづく}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to pack)

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{荷|に}→荷：28294_ni⟧ (luggage, cargo) + {造|づく}り (making)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荷造|にづく}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do packing)
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{荷造|にづく}り (packing for a move)
- ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{荷造|にづく}り (packing for a trip)
- {荷造|にづく}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める (to start packing)
- {荷造|にづく}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}う→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧ (to help with packing)

USAGE:
- Moving house ({引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し)
- Preparing for travel
- Sending packages

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{荷解|にほど}き→荷解き：07956_nihodoki⟧ (unpacking)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{梱包|こんぽう}→梱包：07937_konpou⟧ (commercial packing)
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧ (luggage, baggage)
- ダンボール (cardboard box)

DIFFERENCE FROM {梱包|こんぽう}:
- {荷造|にづく}り: Personal, general packing (moving, travel)
- ⟦{梱包|こんぽう}→梱包：07937_konpou⟧: Professional, commercial packing (shipping)

TIPS FOR MOVING:
- Start {荷造|にづく}り early
- Label boxes by room
- Pack essentials separately

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday conversation.
